name: quality-kernel
description: A quality-assurance kernel for agentic development. Ships a deterministic, red-team-hardened quality GATE (/gate): a risk router (blast-radius tiering from a critical-surface config) + a re-executing referee that RE-RUNS your tests itself (never trusts a 'done' claim), with trusted-base-harness verification so a change cannot pass by neutering or deleting its own tests. Composes with the six-agent SwarmForge engine (Specifier -> Coder -> Cleaner -> Architect -> Hardener -> QA), deterministic tools (CRAP, mutation, DRY), a blind live-oracle, and epistemic-discipline hooks. From a one-line issue to a large feature.
